pacing_rules.on_screen_text: word-synced captions only; no labels or numbers

science_guardrails: Fire-ant mound: irregular dome of soil with NO central opening.
Workers: six legs on the thorax, two waist nodes, elbowed antennae, red-brown head and thorax, darker gaster.
No depths, temperatures, treatment advice or survival claims. The dashed ghost mound is a symbol, not a mechanism.
Underground tunnels are illustrative, not a map.

shots.visual: Big close-up of one fire-ant worker walking left across layered paper ground. On 'colony' the camera pulls far back: the worker becomes one of dozens marching in four rows.

beats.action: Antennae flick up, slight push-in.
Mandibles chomp once.
Fast zoom-out (0.33 s) reveals the crowd. Match cut on the same ant.

shots.camera: Tracks the hero ant, then zooms out from 3.4x to 0.9x.
shots.transition_in: Opens mid-motion; frame 0 already shows the ant.

shots.visual: Backyard: house, fence, green lawn. A fire-ant mound pops up from the lawn, then squashes flat and vanishes.

beats.action: Yard sheet slides up over the crowd; mound pops up with bounce.
Mound stretches, then squashes into the lawn with a dust puff.
Grass blades spring back over the empty spot.

shots.visual: Same yard. A dashed outline marks the missing mound. A magnifying glass swoops in; its lens shows ants still busy in tunnels under the flat lawn.

beats.action: Dashed mound outline draws itself.
Magnifying glass swings in from the right.
Lens settles over the spot; glint sweeps the glass; ants move in the tunnels.
Slow push-in on the lens; ants keep moving.

shots.visual: Hot yellow sky. A big paper sun drops in. A rain cloud dries up. Grass wilts and turns straw-colored.

beats.action: Hard cut; sun drops from the top with a bounce, rays spinning.
Cloud evaporates; grass droops and fades from green to straw, left to right.

shots.visual: Top-down close-up of dry soil. Cracks race outward and the plates pull apart.

beats.action: Whip tilt down from the sky to the ground.
Cracks spread out from the center.
Cracks widen; plate edges lift.

shots.transition_in: Whip pan down with motion blur, 0.16 s.

shots.visual: Side view at ant level on a thick dry crust. The worker walks in, rears back and bites the ground: CLANK. The crust does not dent; the ant bounces back.

beats.action: Ant walks in from the right.
Ant rears back, mandibles open (anticipation).
Strike: impact star, camera shake, ant recoils.

shots.camera: Close side view; shake on impact.

shots.visual: Dust gusts across the crust. A last drop of moisture shrinks away. Cracks open wider.

beats.action: Dust gust streams across.
Dust puff rises; droplet evaporates with a steam curl.

shots.visual: Camera pulls back: three ants on the cracked surface. A dashed ghost mound draws over them, then falls apart. Camera tilts down to show the colony still busy underground.

beats.action: Zoom out to a wider view with three ants.
Ants raise their antennae.
Dashed ghost mound draws over the ants.
Ghost mound dashes fall and scatter.
Tilt down: tunnels and ants underground.
